opportunities.name: Movie-night invite: look up film on IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes, then draft email
opportunities.description: For a given movie, get the IMDb rating, director and runtime, then the Rotten Tomatoes Tomatometer, and write an email inviting a friend to movie night on a given day.
steps: Open imdb.com and type the movie title in the search box
Open the movie's title page (or search results) and note the year, runtime, director and IMDb rating
Open rottentomatoes.com and search for the same title
Open the matching movie result and note the Tomatometer score
Open the mail compose page and enter the recipient in To
Enter the subject 'Movie night <day>: <title>'
Write the body: 'Hi <name>, <day> we watch <title> (<director>, <runtime>): IMDb <rating>, Tomatometer <score>%.'
Click Send (the recording shows Discard being clicked instead)

instances.values: Spirited Away; tom@example.com; Saturday; IMDb 8.6, Tomatometer 96%
The Grand Budapest Hotel (partial: IMDb and RT lookups seen, no email drafted yet)

opportunities.name: npm package health check saved to Notes
opportunities.description: For a given npm package, collect the version, weekly downloads and license from npmjs.com, plus stars, open issues and last release date from its GitHub repo, and save a one-line summary in the Notes app.
steps: Open npmjs.com and type the package name in the search box
Open the exact-match package from the results
Note the version, weekly downloads and license
Click the Repository link to open the GitHub repo
Note the stars, open issues and latest release date
Open the Notes app and type '<pkg>: v<version>, <downloads>/week, <license>, <stars> stars, <issues> open issues, last release <date>'
Press Enter to save the note

instances.values: axios: v1.20.0, 96,527,621/week, MIT, 109.4k stars, 57 issues, last release Sep 13 2026

opportunities.name: Recipe lookup with dish origin saved to Notes
opportunities.description: For a given dish, find the top Allrecipes recipe (rating, time, key ingredients), look up the dish's place of origin on Wikipedia, and save a summary in the Notes app.
steps: Open allrecipes.com and search for the dish
Open the top-rated recipe result and close any popup
Note the rating, total time, servings and the first few ingredients
Open wikipedia.org and search for the dish
Open the article and read 'Place of origin' in the infobox
Open the Notes app and type '<dish> for <n>: <recipe> (<rating> stars, <time>), needs <ingredients>. Origin: <origin>'
Press Enter to save the note

instances.values: shakshuka: Chef John's Shakshuka, 4.8 stars, 50 mins, serves 4; origin Ottoman North Africa
pad thai: Pad Thai recipe; origin Thailand
